narr: A small cluster of strong to severe thunderstorms developed along a weak cold front as it pushed southeast across western Kentucky. A few of the storms produced wind gusts around 60 mph. A slow-moving thunderstorm caused isolated flash flooding of an urban area.
ev: Several roads in Madisonville were closed due to flash flooding. Storm total rainfall of 2 to 3 inches was reported in the Madisonville area.
lsr: SEVERAL ROAD CLOSURES IN MADISONVILLE DUE TO FLASH FLOODING.
